items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I did a thing with Benny then on "Honeysuckle Rose."

ctx.x: Tell me about 1938 when you were with Benny Goodman at Carnegie. It says here that was the first time you played Carnegie, I think. What do you remember of that?

Well, I can remember that -- well, I know it was a Benny Goodman concert, and it was like the first jazz concert that I heard in Carnegie and was the one I had the pleasure of being a part of it. I did a thing with Benny then on "Honeysuckle Rose."
